slides.texte_overlay: How to stand out in your 20s

BE THE EARLY ONE

Most people your age start late.
Start at 6.

DRESS ONE LEVEL UP

Not expensive. Just intentional.

WRITE REAL MESSAGES

Thank-you notes. Long emails.
People remember effort.

KNOW THINGS

History, science, art.
Rare in a world of scrolling.
